dvl_link.convention: R_base_dvl maps a vector in dvl_link to base_link, both FLU: v_base = R_base_dvl * v_dvl. Columns are the DVL x, y, z axes expressed in base_link. It equals Rz(yaw_deg) and the 2026-11-11 /tf_static quaternion (0, 0, 0.9239, -0.3827).
dvl_link.reason: The log's /tf_static says dvl_link has no rotation, but the DVL was mounted rotated (reported by the team, 2026-11-11). dvl_mount_fit.py finds the best fit at -135 deg (residual 0.0763 vs 0.1166 m/s^2 at 0 deg); the 2026-11-11 log's /tf_static also gives -135 deg for the same mount.
